text: このへんの　うみって　あったかいわ！

structure.jp: このへんの　うみって

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.explanation: って here is a casual way to bring up what you are talking about, like は. うみって = 'the sea, you know,'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end gives a soft, feminine tone to what is said. あったかいわ = 'it's so warm!'
